name: fioreze-portais-app
description: Plataforma digital unificada da Familia Fioreze em Cloudflare Workers, Static Assets e D1.

scripts.validate: npm run structure:check && npm run lint && npm run pages:check && npm test && npm run wrangler:check
scripts.pages:dev: npm run pages:build && node scripts/run-pages-wrangler.js dev
scripts.pages:deploy: npm run pages:build && node scripts/run-pages-wrangler.js deploy
scripts.db:inspect:local: wrangler d1 execute fioreze-portais-db-dev --local --command="SELECT name FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name"
